title: Define Papyrus shared chat trust boundary contract
description: Add a code-local reusable admission contract for site-hosted shared chat. Inject a verified Papyrus principal and membership resolver; derive Account/site/editor on the server; enforce private per-editor transcript ownership and operation-scoped idempotency with payload-reuse rejection. Cover rejection and replay behavior in tests and Gherkin. Document that JWT audience, client_id and token_use are distinct and that the production token type and verifier configuration must be verified before wiring. No exposed endpoint, live AppSync changes, live IAM/OIDC, or deployment.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Authentication regression: confirmed published Papyrus 5.41.1 newsroom uses Cognito tokens while hosted chat requires an unconnected sealed Prospectus session. Fix verifies newsroom JWT issuer/client/token use/expiry/editor role, binds the Google-only challenge to the same verified subject, and requires validated publishing Account selection. No Account or role creation. Added executable Gherkin, cryptographic wrong-subject rejection, browser connection/selection, and cross-editor transcript/turn-stream tests. Release is constrained: current develop contains unrelated features; do not promote PR #722 for this fix.
